label: Equipment compatibility and atomic equip
brief:
Create exactly one standalone Godot 4.5 GDScript file. It must start with "extends RefCounted" and have no class_name, imports, external assets, print calls or network/file access. Implement:
- configure(definitions: Dictionary, quantities: Dictionary) -> void; replace internal state, starting empty slots "weapon" and "offhand" both containing the string "none".
- equip(item_id: String) -> bool; reject missing/zero quantity and missing definitions, reject incompatible hands without changing state, otherwise assign item to the specified slot.
- unequip(slot: String) -> bool; only "weapon"/"offhand" are valid; clear a filled slot to "none"; reject invalid or empty slots.
- snapshot() -> Dictionary; return {"weapon": current_id, "offhand": current_id}.
Definitions are dictionaries like {"sword":{"slot":"weapon","two_handed":false},"greatsword":{"slot":"weapon","two_handed":true},"shield":{"slot":"offhand"}}.
When a two_handed weapon is equipped, the offhand must be empty; when an offhand is equipped, the current weapon must not be two_handed. Never auto-unequip. An invalid action must not change either slot. Use only Godot 4-compatible GDScript. Output only the complete script, no explanations.

label: Transactional recipe crafting with region gates
brief:
Create exactly one standalone Godot 4.5 GDScript file. It must start with "extends RefCounted" and have no class_name, imports, external assets, print calls or network/file access. Implement:
- configure(stock: Dictionary, recipes: Dictionary, unlocked_regions: Array) -> void; initialize internal state as deep copies.
- craft(recipe_id: String) -> bool; reject unknown recipes, locked regions and insufficient materials WITHOUT changing stock. On success, subtract every required material and add exactly one output item, atomically.
- inventory() -> Dictionary; return a deep copy of current stock.
A recipe record is {"region":"forest","materials":{"iron":3,"wood":2},"output":"sword"}. A region is unlocked iff its exact string appears in unlocked_regions. Missing items have quantity 0. Never allow a negative stock. A recipe with zero or negative material requirements is invalid and must be rejected unchanged. No external state or persistence. Use only Godot 4-compatible GDScript. Output only the complete script, no explanations.

label: Battle healing, cleansing and revival with resource accounting
brief:
Create exactly one standalone Godot 4.5 GDScript file. It must start with "extends RefCounted" and have no class_name, imports, external assets, print calls or network/file access. Implement:
- configure(caster: Dictionary, allies: Array) -> void; copy inputs deeply; caster has {"mp":20,"turns":3}, allies are dictionaries like {"hp":40,"max_hp":100,"poisoned":false}.
- cast(kind: String, target_index: int) -> bool.
- snapshot() -> Dictionary; return a deep copy {"caster": caster_data, "allies": ally_data}.
Exactly these three commands:
"heal": costs 6 MP and 1 turn; adds 20 HP capped at max_hp; target must be alive (hp>0) and below max_hp.
"cleanse": costs 4 MP and 1 turn; clears poisoned on a living poisoned target.
"revive": costs 12 MP and 1 turn; if target hp=0, sets hp=10 (capped at max_hp) and poisoned=false.
Reject unknown commands, negative/out-of-range targets, insufficient MP, no turns, or commands that would make no change. Invalid casts return false with no MP, turns or ally-state changes. Use only Godot 4-compatible GDScript. Output only the complete script, no explanations.
